titre: Prothèses de genou et de hanche chez les patients âgés américains
sous_titre: Nombre d'opérations par an, 2013, 2022 et projection 2040

2013.texte: Annual primary total hip arthroplasty (THA) volume increased from 305,082 in 2013 to 594,981 in 2022

2022.texte: The annual adjusted primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA) volume increased from 603,704 in 2013 to 1,013,533 in 2022

2040.texte: is projected to reach 2,793,919 by 2040, with an annual growth rate of 5.9% from 2023 to 2040
